svg.text: ENTERPRISE CONVERSATIONAL BI: RAW TEXT-TO-SQL VS. GOVERNED SEMANTIC LAYER
Stop Letting LLMs Write Raw JOINs: Text-to-Semantic-Intent Reaches 98.6% KPI Accuracy
800 Warehouse Tables / 200K Queries/Mo: Tier 1 Raw DDL SQL (58.5% Accuracy, $215K/mo) vs. Tier 4 Cube/MetricFlow + AST Gate (98.6%, $26K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: Raw DDL Text-to-SQL Chaos
1. 1-to-N Join Fan-Out & Metric Drift (41.5% Wrong KPI Numbers):
• Joining `orders` with `order_items` inflates `SUM(order_shipping)` by 4x;
• Forgets `WHERE is_test_tenant=false AND status='SETTLED'` filters!
2. Runaway 50TB Full-Table Scans (8.2% Incident Rate):
• Missing partition keys or Cartesian joins burn $250+ per query
in Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks serverless compute!
3. Shared Service-Account Row-Level Security (RLS) Bypass (12.4%):
• Regional sales manager queries global payroll/revenue tables
Production Failure Impact (800 Tables / 200K Queries/Mo):
• Executive KPI Accuracy: Only 58.5% (Tier 1) | 80.6% (Tier 2)
• Runaway Scan Rate: 8.2% | RLS Bypass Exposure Risk: 12.4%
• Monthly Warehouse Waste & Analyst Rework: $215,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Semantic Layer + SQLGlot AST Gate + OAuth RLS
1. Text-to-Semantic-Intent (`dbt MetricFlow / Cube / Fabric DAX`):
• LLM selects `{metrics: ["net_arr"], dims: ["region"]}`; deterministic
compiler generates symmetric-aggregate SQL (0% fan-out inflation!)
2. SQLGlot AST Linter + 15ms EXPLAIN Byte-Cap Gate (`<=10GB`):
• Blocks CROSS JOIN, missing date partition filters & queries exceeding
10GB estimated scan before touching warehouse compute (0.0% runaway)
3. End-to-End OAuth Identity Pass-Through & Semantic RLS:
• Enforces caller's Entra ID row/column security policies (0.0% leak)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Executive KPI Accuracy: 98.6% (+40.1 pts vs. Tier 1)
• Runaway Full-Table Scans: 0.0% | RLS Exposure Risk: 0.0%
• Monthly Total TCO: $26,000 / mo (-87.9% savings vs. Tier 1)
